title: Using the Renewable Generation Dashboard
text: dashboard consists several components, including summary boxes, filter options, plots, data tables. ’s brief overview component: Region Selector left side dashboard, dropdown selector labelled “Select Region.” dropdown allows users filter data region, displaying metrics visualizations specific selected region. Available regions include (e.g., NSW1, QLD1, etc.). Summary Boxes top dashboard, four summary boxes display key metrics selected region: Total Demand: Shows total operational demand (MW) selected region. Average Demand: Shows average operational demand (MW) selected region. Total Generation: Shows total renewable power generation (MW) selected region. Average Generation: Shows average renewable power generation (MW) selected region. values update automatically based selected region. Trend Visualization main panel dashboard features line plot comparing Mean Power Generation Mean Operational Demand across different times day selected region. Key aspects plot include: Green Line: Represents mean power generation MW time. Red Line: Represents mean operational demand MW time. Dashed Vertical Lines: Show standard daytime start (7:00 ) end (6:00 PM) hours, aiding users analysing demand patterns. Data Table bottom dashboard, table displays detailed records operational demand power generation time interval selected region. Users can sort search data table examine specific records. “’m Feeling Lucky” Button “’m Feeling Lucky” button available sidebar. clicked, opens surprise link new browser tab entertaining Easter egg.
